title: PLAXIS 3D基础教程
source_processing: All 378 original scan page images retained locally and reviewed page by page.
Windows OCR produced page text and word bounding boxes as a reading aid.
User supplied Adobe-searchable PDF; text extracted for all pages and used to cross-check difficult content.
Page correspondence checked across all 378 pages by rendered thumbnails; blank reverse-page cleanup is excluded from content identity inference.
Published material consists of authored summaries, parameter semantics, example tables, page locators and unresolved-source notes; raw scans and full OCR are excluded.
limits: Coverage means each page was read and its knowledge indexed; it is not a claim of error-free character-for-character transcription.
Example values are source-defined, not automatically confirmed for a new engineering project.
Book contradictions and illegible or incomplete items remain explicit rather than guessed.
Current-version API properties and example calculations are not all runtime-validated.
Bibliography entries are reading leads, not claims that the cited publications were independently read.
